cohort: 181 women with Cesarean scar pregnancy who underwent ultrasound-guided vacuum aspiration
finding: Women with a COS-1 classification had a higher incidence of treatment failure and other complications after ultrasound-guided vacuum aspiration for Cesarean scar pregnancy compared to women with COS-2.
mod_finding: This study investigated the use of ultrasound in predicting treatment outcomes for Cesarean scar pregnancies managed with vacuum aspiration and did not compare different modes of delivery.
